about: Scacelith realtime protocol, version 1: the single source of the wire format. protogen (crates/protocol, `cargo run -p scacelith-protocol --features gen --bin protogen`) validates this file and writes the Rust codec (crates/protocol/src/gen.rs), the game's C++ codec (src/net/protocol_gen.h/.cpp), the tables of docs/PROTOCOL.md and the golden vectors (test/fixtures/protocol-vectors.json). Keys named `doc` or ending in `Doc` are prose: they are left out of the fingerprint and of the frozen manifests (protocol/frozen/). Field types: u8 u16 u32 u64 i32 f64 id53 bool str8 enum:<Enum> struct:<Struct> list16:<scalar or struct:Struct>; `min`/`max` bound integers, string byte lengths (str8) and item counts (list16).

constants.name: MaxClientMessage
constants.doc: Largest client message, in bytes (type byte included). The server refuses a larger WebSocket message from its frame header, before reading it (close 1009).

constants.name: MaxServerMessage
constants.doc: Largest server message, in bytes (type byte included).

constants.name: MaxPlies
constants.doc: Plies a game may have: a game that reaches it ends (EndReason ServerAborted). Ply indexes are 0..1199.

enums.name: Color
enums.doc: A side of the board. None: no side (no clock running, no offer pending, a rematch window without an offer).

enums.name: ColorPref
enums.doc: Colour asked for in a challenge, or offered to the player who receives it.

enums.name: GameStatus
enums.doc: Result of a game. The same numbers are the `status` of the game records of the HTTPS API.

values.name: Aborted
values.doc: no result, unrated

enums.name: EndReason
enums.doc: Why a game ended. 0..13 are the game's chess::GameEndReason values (14..19 are kept for new ones), 20 and above happen online only. The same numbers are the `reason` of the game records of the HTTPS API.
enums.unknownDoc: show a generic end of game: `status` gives the result

values.name: None
values.doc: the game is not over

values.name: IllegalMoves
values.doc: offline games only

values.name: TimeoutVsInsufficient
values.doc: flag fell but the opponent cannot mate: draw

values.name: IllegalMovesVsInsufficient
values.doc: offline games only

values.name: Abandonment
values.doc: disconnected longer than the reconnection grace: loss

values.name: AbandonmentVsInsufficient
values.doc: abandoned, but the opponent cannot mate: draw

values.name: Aborted
values.doc: aborted by a player before their first move (unrated)

values.name: NoShow
values.doc: a first move not made in time (aborted, unrated)

values.name: Forfeit
values.doc: certain cheat: loss

values.name: ServerAborted
values.doc: the server could not continue the game, or it reached MaxPlies (unrated)

values.name: BothDisconnected
values.doc: both players vanished at the same time (aborted, unrated)

enums.name: GameEventKind
enums.doc: What a GameEvent reports. 0 is never assigned.

values.name: DrawOffered
values.doc: color = the player who offers

values.name: DrawDeclined
values.doc: color = the player who declines (also when they move instead of answering)

values.name: PlayerDisconnected
values.doc: color = who; arg = their reconnection grace in ms

values.name: PlayerReconnected
values.doc: color = who

values.name: RematchOffered
values.doc: color = the player who offers (after the end)

values.name: RematchDeclined
values.doc: color = the player who declines, or None when the offer expired

enums.name: QueueState
enums.doc: State of the player in a matchmaking queue.

values.name: Left
values.doc: not in the queue (left, or never joined)

values.name: Matched
values.doc: a game was found: its GameSnapshot follows

enums.name: ChallengeState
enums.doc: State of a challenge or of a private game waiting for its code.

values.name: Accepted
values.doc: the game starts: its GameSnapshot follows

values.name: Unavailable
values.doc: the other player cannot play it any more (offline, in a game, refusing challenges)

enums.name: NoticeCode
enums.doc: What a Notice announces. 0 is never assigned.

values.name: ServerShutdown
values.doc: arg = ms before the shutdown

values.name: Banned
values.doc: arg = end of the ban (epoch ms); the connection closes (4004)

values.name: SessionRevoked
values.doc: the session token was revoked; the connection closes (4003)

values.name: MatchmakingCooldown
values.doc: arg = end of the cooldown (epoch ms)

values.name: ReplacedByNewConnection
values.doc: another connection of the account took over; the connection closes (4007)

values.name: RatingRestored
values.doc: arg = rating points given back: an opponent of your rated games was banned for cheating

reserved.name: Motd
reserved.doc: retired (never sent: the message of the day comes from /api/v1/info)

enums.name: ErrorCode
enums.doc: Why a request was refused (Error.code, MoveRejected.code). 1..99: connection, 100..199: game, 200..239: lobby, 240..255: violations. A fatal Error carries a connection or violation code, and the close code that follows is 4000 + code (1..99) or 4300 + (code - 240) (240..255). 0 is never assigned.
enums.unknownDoc: a generic refusal of the request quoted by `ref` (when `fatal`, the connection closes)

values.name: Malformed
values.doc: a message that does not decode (fatal)

values.name: UnsupportedProtocol
values.doc: Hello.proto is not 1 (fatal): update the game

values.name: Unauthorized
values.doc: session token refused (fatal): log in again

values.name: Banned
values.doc: account banned (fatal, after Notice Banned)

values.name: RateLimited
values.doc: too many messages: this one was dropped (never fatal)

values.name: ServerFull
values.doc: no room for a new player (fatal)

values.name: Replaced
values.doc: another connection of the account took over (fatal)

values.name: ShuttingDown
values.doc: the server is shutting down (fatal)

values.name: Internal
values.doc: unexpected server failure (fatal at Hello, otherwise the request only)

values.name: HelloRequired
values.doc: the first message was not a Hello, or none came in time (fatal)

values.name: EmailUnverified
values.doc: the account's e-mail address is not verified (fatal)

values.name: NotInGame
values.doc: the game does not exist or the player does not play it

values.name: StalePly
values.doc: a different move for a ply already played

values.name: Desync
values.doc: ply ahead of the game, or posHash of another position

values.name: InvalidCategory
values.doc: not an official category of this server

values.name: FlagFell
values.doc: the mover's flag fell before the move arrived (GameEnd follows)

values.name: RatedRepeatLimit
values.doc: rated game refused: MATCH_REPEAT_LIMIT reached with this player

values.name: ProtocolViolation
values.doc: a message that decodes but is not allowed here (fatal unless stated)

values.name: Flood
values.doc: message or gesture flood (fatal)

values.name: CheatDetected
values.doc: certain cheat (fatal)

reserved.name: SlowConsumer
reserved.doc: never sent in an Error: a client that does not read gets close 4303 alone

bits.name: Side
bits.doc: the look falls on the table beside the board (clock, captured pieces, scoresheet); each client puts the clock at its own player's right, so the receiver mirrors the look (negates its yaw)

closeCodes.name: Normal
closeCodes.doc: normal closure (a client that logs out or quits)

closeCodes.name: GoingAway
closeCodes.doc: heartbeat timeout: nothing received from the client for the server's HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS

closeCodes.name: ProtocolError
closeCodes.doc: WebSocket protocol error (unmasked client frame, reserved bits or opcode, bad control frame)

closeCodes.name: TooBig
closeCodes.doc: a client message larger than MaxClientMessage

closeCodes.name: Malformed
closeCodes.doc: a client message that does not decode; reconnect with backoff

closeCodes.name: UnsupportedProtocol
closeCodes.doc: no automatic retry: update the game

closeCodes.name: Unauthorized
closeCodes.doc: no automatic retry: log in again

closeCodes.name: Internal
closeCodes.doc: an unexpected server error; reconnect with backoff

closeCodes.name: HelloRequired
closeCodes.doc: no Hello within WS_HELLO_TIMEOUT_MS, or another message first

closeCodes.name: EmailUnverified
closeCodes.doc: no automatic retry: verify the e-mail address

closeCodes.name: ProtocolViolation
closeCodes.doc: a client message out of place (a Hello whose seq is not 1, a forged type the server does not sanction)

closeCodes.name: Flood
closeCodes.doc: rate limits exceeded again and again

closeCodes.name: SlowConsumer
closeCodes.doc: the client does not read its messages (more than WS_SEND_BUFFER_LIMIT bytes queued): no Error precedes it; 4300 + (243 - 240), 243 being the reserved code SlowConsumer

structs.name: PlayerInfo
structs.doc: A player as shown to others.

fields.name: rating
fields.doc: rating in the game's category

fields.name: provisional
fields.doc: the rating is still provisional

structs.name: MoveRec
structs.doc: A move of a game record.

fields.name: move
fields.doc: packed move (Move encoding)

fields.name: spentMs
fields.doc: clock time charged for the move after lag compensation (0 for plies 0 and 1)

fields.name: clockMs
fields.doc: mover's remaining time after the move, increment included

structs.name: RatingChange
structs.doc: Rating of one player before and after a rated game.

fields.name: games
fields.doc: rated games in the category, this one included

fields.name: provisional
fields.doc: the new rating is still provisional

messages.name: Hello
messages.doc: First message of a connection. Its first five fields (the Hello prefix: type, seq, proto, minor, caps) are frozen for every version, so that any server can read them and answer any client.

fields.name: proto
fields.doc: major protocol version: 1

fields.name: minor
fields.doc: highest minor version the client speaks

fields.name: caps
fields.doc: capabilities the client supports (bit set)

fields.name: client
fields.doc: client name and version, for the logs ("Scacelith/1.5.0 win64")

fields.name: token
fields.doc: session token from the HTTPS login of this server

messages.name: Ping
messages.doc: Round-trip and clock-offset probe of the client, answered by the server Pong. At most one is answered per 950 ms.

messages.name: Pong
messages.doc: Answer to the server Ping, sent at once (the server measures the latency with it).

fields.name: nonce
fields.doc: nonce of the server Ping

messages.name: QueueJoin
messages.doc: Join the matchmaking queue of an official category. Answered by Ack or Error; QueueStatus messages follow.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: category id ("3+2")

fields.name: rated
fields.doc: false: casual queue

messages.name: QueueLeave
messages.doc: Leave the matchmaking queue. Answered by Ack or Error; QueueStatus Left follows.

messages.name: ChallengeCreate
messages.doc: Challenge a player by name, or (empty target) create a private game joined with a code. Rated only with an official time control. Answered by Ack or Error; ChallengeStatus follows (with the code of a private game).

fields.name: target
fields.doc: username, or empty for a private game

fields.name: color
fields.doc: colour asked for by the challenger

messages.name: ChallengeAccept
messages.doc: Accept a challenge received. Answered by Ack or Error; the game's GameSnapshot follows.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: challenge id (ChallengeReceived.id)

messages.name: ChallengeDecline
messages.doc: Decline a challenge received. Answered by Ack or Error.

messages.name: ChallengeCancel
messages.doc: Withdraw one's own challenge or private game. Answered by Ack or Error.

messages.name: ChallengeJoinCode
messages.doc: Join a private game by its code. Answered by Ack or Error; the game's GameSnapshot follows.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: code as shown ("K7QX-9M2P"); the server ignores dashes, spaces and case

messages.name: Move
messages.doc: Move intent for ply `ply` of game `game`. Answered by MoveMade (to both players), or by MoveRejected followed by a GameSnapshot (to the mover only).

fields.name: ply
fields.doc: index of the move in the game (0 = White's first move)

fields.name: move
fields.doc: packed move (Move encoding)

fields.name: posHash
fields.doc: digest of the position the move is played in

fields.name: thinkMs
fields.doc: client-measured time since the turn began (bounds the lag compensation only)

fields.name: drawOffer
fields.doc: the move comes with a draw offer

messages.name: Resign
messages.doc: Resign a running game. GameEnd follows, or Error.

messages.name: DrawOffer
messages.doc: Offer a draw. The opponent receives GameEvent DrawOffered; a refusal is an Error.

messages.name: DrawAnswer
messages.doc: Answer the opponent's draw offer: GameEnd (accepted) or GameEvent DrawDeclined follows, or Error.

messages.name: DrawClaim
messages.doc: Claim a draw by threefold repetition or the fifty-move rule in the current position. GameEnd follows, or Error NothingToClaim.

messages.name: Abort
messages.doc: Abort the game before one's own first move (unrated). GameEnd follows, or Error AbortNotAllowed.

messages.name: Resync
messages.doc: Ask for the game's GameSnapshot.

messages.name: Rematch
messages.doc: After the end: accept = true offers (or accepts) a rematch with colours swapped, accept = false declines or withdraws. GameEvent or the new game's GameSnapshot follows, or Error RematchUnavailable.

messages.name: Gesture
messages.doc: The player's live, cosmetic state in game `game`, relayed to the opponent byte for byte (server Gesture) and never answered, stored or looked at beyond decoding. Sent when it changes and at least once a second, paced by Welcome.gestureRate and gestureBurst.

fields.name: ply
fields.doc: plies played when the current state of the hand (touch, aim, placed, Promoting) began

fields.name: touch
fields.doc: square of the piece in hand (64 = none)

fields.name: aim
fields.doc: square the piece is aimed at (64 = none)

fields.name: placed
fields.doc: move placed on the board before the clock press, packed (0 = none)

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: GestureFlag bits

fields.name: yaw
fields.doc: look, milliradians, seat-relative, > 0 to the left

fields.name: pitch
fields.doc: look, milliradians, < 0 down

fields.name: lean
fields.doc: lean towards the board, percent

messages.name: Welcome
messages.doc: Hello accepted. Its first three fields (proto, minor, caps) are frozen for every version. When activeGame != 0 a GameSnapshot of that game follows.

fields.name: minor
fields.doc: negotiated minor: min(Hello.minor, server minor)

fields.name: caps
fields.doc: negotiated capabilities: Hello.caps AND server capabilities

fields.name: serverTime
fields.doc: server clock (epoch ms) when the session was accepted

fields.name: heartbeatMs
fields.doc: interval of the server Ping (HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS)

fields.name: clientPingMs
fields.doc: interval of the client Ping the server wants (0 = the client's default, 10 s)

fields.name: maxMsgPerSec
fields.doc: messages per second a client may send, sustained (WS_MSG_RATE)

fields.name: msgBurst
fields.doc: message burst a client may send above it (WS_MSG_BURST)

fields.name: activeGame
fields.doc: the player's game in progress (0 = none)

fields.name: gestureRate
fields.doc: gestures per second the server relays, sustained (0 = no relay: send none)

fields.name: gestureBurst
fields.doc: gesture burst above gestureRate (0 when gestureRate is 0)

messages.name: Error
messages.doc: A request was refused. Frozen layout for every version. fatal: the server closes the connection right after it (close code 4000 + code or 4300 + (code - 240)).

fields.name: ref
fields.doc: seq of the message refused (0 when no message caused it)

fields.name: game
fields.doc: game concerned (0 = none)

messages.name: Ping
messages.doc: Heartbeat, about every Welcome.heartbeatMs: answer with the client Pong at once.

fields.name: serverTime
fields.doc: server clock (epoch ms) when sent

messages.name: Pong
messages.doc: Answer to the client Ping.

fields.name: nonce
fields.doc: nonce of the client Ping

fields.name: serverTime
fields.doc: server clock (epoch ms) when sent

messages.name: Ack
messages.doc: A lobby request (QueueJoin ... ChallengeJoinCode) succeeded: each one gets exactly one Ack or one Error.

fields.name: ref
fields.doc: seq of the request

messages.name: Notice
messages.doc: An announcement from the server (NoticeCode).

fields.name: arg
fields.doc: see NoticeCode (0 when unused)

messages.name: QueueStatus
messages.doc: The player's state in a matchmaking queue: on join, every few seconds while searching, when matched and when left.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: category id (may be empty for Left)

fields.name: waitMs
fields.doc: time spent in the queue

fields.name: window
fields.doc: current rating window (Searching; 0 otherwise)

fields.name: queued
fields.doc: players in this queue (Searching; 0 otherwise)

messages.name: ChallengeReceived
messages.doc: A player challenges the receiver.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: challenge id

fields.name: yourColor
fields.doc: colour offered to the receiver

fields.name: expiresMs
fields.doc: time left to accept

messages.name: ChallengeStatus
messages.doc: State of a challenge for its creator (and for its receiver when it is cancelled or expires).

fields.name: target
fields.doc: username challenged (empty for a private game)

fields.name: code
fields.doc: code of a private game (empty otherwise)

messages.name: GameSnapshot
messages.doc: Complete authoritative state of a game: when it starts (both players), after Welcome when activeGame != 0, on Resync, after every MoveRejected, and unsolicited to the opponent when the held clock of a game restored after a restart starts. Clocks are the remaining times at serverTime; the `running` side counts down from there.

fields.name: gseq
fields.doc: number of the game's last event (MoveMade, GameEvent, GameEnd) included in this state

fields.name: category
fields.doc: official category id, or "custom"

fields.name: you
fields.doc: the receiver's colour (White or Black)

fields.name: running
fields.doc: side whose clock runs from serverTime (None: no clock runs)

fields.name: drawOffer
fields.doc: side with a pending draw offer (None: none)

fields.name: graceMs
fields.doc: reconnection grace of this game

fields.name: firstMoveMs
fields.doc: time left for the next player's first move (plies 0 and 1; 0 otherwise)

fields.name: startedAt
fields.doc: server clock (epoch ms) when the game was created

fields.name: rematch
fields.doc: side with a pending rematch offer (None: none)

fields.name: autoPress
fields.doc: the robots press the clock by themselves (fixed when the game was created)

messages.name: MoveMade
messages.doc: A move accepted by the server, to both players (for the mover it is the confirmation). Re-sent byte for byte when the mover repeats the same move for the same ply.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: MoveFlag bits

fields.name: spentMs
fields.doc: clock time charged for the move

fields.name: drawOffer
fields.doc: the move came with a draw offer

fields.name: firstMoveMs
fields.doc: time the next player has for their first move (0 when not applicable: the side to move's clock runs from serverTime)

messages.name: MoveRejected
messages.doc: The move intent was refused (to the mover only; never shown to the opponent). A GameSnapshot always follows; FlagFell is also followed by GameEnd.

messages.name: GameEvent
messages.doc: Something happened in a game (GameEventKind).

fields.name: arg
fields.doc: see GameEventKind (0 when unused)

messages.name: GameEnd
messages.doc: Final result, to both players. Rated games: RatingUpdate follows once the result is committed.

messages.name: RatingUpdate
messages.doc: Rating changes of a finished rated game, once the result is committed.

messages.name: Gesture
messages.doc: The opponent's gestures: the client Gesture without its seq, byte for byte. Cosmetic, never authoritative.
